result: Five tables. customers(CustomerID INTEGER UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY, Segment TEXT, Currency TEXT); gasstations(GasStationID INTEGER UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY, ChainID INTEGER, Country TEXT, Segment TEXT); products(ProductID INTEGER UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY, Description TEXT); transactions_1k(TransactionID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, Date DATE, Time TEXT, CustomerID INTEGER, CardID INTEGER, GasStationID INTEGER, ProductID INTEGER, Amount INTEGER, Price REAL); yearmonth(CustomerID INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers, Date TEXT NOT NULL, Consumption REAL, PRIMARY KEY (Date, CustomerID)). Only yearmonth declares a foreign key; transactions_1k declares none.
validation_method: SQLite schema inspection via read-only connection
